evidence.quote: goes by the river path entrance
The river path is where the flats happen.

observations.why: Present-tense assertion about the actual, settled placement of a named location; concrete throughout, with no hedging or hypothetical framing.

evidence.quote: Put the pump on a chain
the last one walked off in a week

observations.why: Imperative directive aims attention at a future, planned action; the past event cited as its rationale is realis but supports the directive rather than setting its temporal focus, so future/irrealis is the stronger read.
